positions.as_written: Measure strength through range rather than at one angle, since both the arm and the muscle change.
Treat effusion as a cause of reduced internal moment before concluding muscle failure.
Expect co-contraction to raise joint load in painful and unstable knees, and read modelled loads accordingly.
Treat the internal moment as the half of the equation surgery usually cannot fix.
Expect a hamstring graft to remove part of the internal flexion moment, and account for it in rehabilitation.
Treat a quadriceps deficit as a mechanical problem rather than a motivational one.
